items.title: Introducing Claude for Manufacturing
items.summary: A new plugin with 17 skills and four connectors helps manufacturers draft quotes, quality reports, and supplier requests from the systems they already run.

items.title: Operate Claude Managed Agents inside your security perimeter
items.summary: Introducing self-hosted Claude Managed Agents. Now you can run agents in your own environment, whether that’s in your own cloud or on-premise. You host the agents, credentials, and session history, and choose where requests to Claude are sent.
